readme.en:
Connect your Desi smart locks, relays, and security alarm systems to Homey to create a fully integrated and secure smart home experience. This app allows you to seamlessly manage your home access and security devices in one place, giving you peace of mind whether you are at home or away.

Automate your daily routines by securing your doors automatically when you leave and arming your alarms at night. By integrating these essential components, you can effortlessly monitor your home's safety status and create convenient schedules that fit your everyday life perfectly.

For optimal performance, it is recommended to remove devices individually before uninstalling the integration. Please keep in mind that standard API rate limits apply; if you encounter a rate limit error, access will automatically be restored after 24 hours.

description.en: A smarter way to secure home

changelog.en: Improved platform compatibility and device performance.

readme.en:
Bring your BLUETTI power station into Homey. See its battery level, solar and grid input, power use and remaining time, switch the AC and DC outputs, and use it all in Flows. Changes made on the power station or in the BLUETTI app show up in Homey within seconds, and an optional Bluetooth fallback keeps the readings coming when Wi-Fi or the BLUETTI cloud is down.

This is a community app, not made or supported by BLUETTI, and tested with the Elite 30 V2. Your power station must be set up on Wi-Fi with the BLUETTI app. Results with other models, questions and details are welcome in the Homey Community topic.

readme.en:
Elpriser.dk shows your electricity price for every quarter-hour in Homey: the spot price with your grid company's tariff, Energinet's tariffs, electricity tax and VAT. Add a device with your postal code. If the postal code has more than one grid company, you choose your own, because the grid company sets the tariff in your price. The device shows the price for the quarter-hour running and how it compares with the rest of the day.

Use the price in your Flows. Start the dishwasher in the cheapest hours before a deadline, run the heat pump when the quarter-hour is among the day's cheapest hours, or get a message when tomorrow's prices arrive, usually between 13:00 and 15:00. The prices come from Elpriser.dk and are based on data from Energi Data Service by Energinet. Your electricity supplier's markup and subscription are not included. No account is needed.
readme.da:
Elpriser.dk viser din elpris for hvert kvarter i Homey: spotprisen med dit netselskabs tarif, Energinets tariffer, elafgift og moms. Tilføj en enhed med dit postnummer. Har postnummeret mere end ét netselskab, vælger du dit eget, for netselskabet bestemmer tariffen i din pris. Enheden viser prisen for det kvarter, der er i gang, og hvordan den ligger i forhold til resten af døgnet.

Brug prisen i dine Flows. Start opvaskemaskinen i de billigste timer inden en frist, kør varmepumpen, når kvarteret er blandt døgnets billigste timer, eller få besked, når morgendagens priser kommer, typisk mellem kl. 13 og 15. Priserne kommer fra Elpriser.dk og bygger på data fra Energi Data Service fra Energinet. Elselskabets tillæg og abonnement er ikke med. Du skal ikke oprette en konto.

readme.en:
Know about the rain before it arrives. MeteoVeo is a weather service for Spain built on measurements from radar, thousands of nearby weather stations and AEMET, and this app brings it to your Homey: rain in the next hour in 10-minute steps, AEMET warnings for your area and the conditions at your home, ready to retract the awning, skip the watering or close the blinds with your Flows. Two dashboard widgets show the forecast in the look of the MeteoVeo app and a radar loop around your home. Available for mainland Spain, the Balearic and Canary Islands, Ceuta and Melilla.

The app is free and works with a free MeteoVeo account. Lightning near your home is part of MeteoVeo Plus, MeteoVeo's paid plan (€1.99 a month or €14.99 a year, with a free trial), which you can get in the MeteoVeo app for Android and iPhone. Own a weather station? Send its readings to MeteoVeo with Flows: they make your forecast more accurate, and for as long as your station keeps reporting, MeteoVeo Plus is free for you.
readme.es:
Entérate de la lluvia antes de que llegue. MeteoVeo es un servicio meteorológico para España hecho con medidas del radar, de miles de estaciones cercanas y de AEMET, y esta app lo lleva a tu Homey: la lluvia de la próxima hora en pasos de 10 minutos, los avisos de AEMET de tu zona y las condiciones en tu casa, listos para recoger el toldo, saltarte el riego o bajar las persianas con tus Flows. Dos widgets para el panel muestran la previsión con el aspecto de la app de MeteoVeo y el radar en bucle alrededor de tu casa. Disponible en la España peninsular, Baleares, Canarias, Ceuta y Melilla.

La app es gratuita y funciona con una cuenta gratuita de MeteoVeo. Los rayos cerca de tu casa forman parte de MeteoVeo Plus, el plan de pago de MeteoVeo (1,99 € al mes o 14,99 € al año, con prueba gratuita), que puedes contratar en la app de MeteoVeo para Android e iPhone. ¿Tienes una estación meteorológica? Envía sus medidas a MeteoVeo con Flows: afinan tu previsión y, mientras tu estación siga enviándolas, MeteoVeo Plus es gratis para ti.

readme.en:
Connect your email accounts directly to your smart home with IMAP Client. By monitoring your mailboxes in real time, Homey can immediately react the moment an important email arrives—whether it is a package delivery notification, a security alert from an external service, or an urgent message from a specific sender. With optional SMTP support, Homey can also send, reply to, and forward emails, allowing your smart home to dispatch custom notifications, status updates, or camera snapshots directly to any recipient.

Use your incoming emails to trigger lights and announcements, automatically mail security images when motion is detected, or celebrate reaching inbox zero when a mailbox is cleared. Seamlessly integrate two-way email communication into your daily smart home automations.

readme.en:
Let your home ventilation respond to CO₂, humidity and your daily routine. Set the fan mode, start a boost, reset the filter counter and see CO₂, humidity, temperatures and bypass position of your heat recovery unit. Physical remotes become flow triggers, room sensors become Homey devices, and every packet on the bus can start a flow.

The app connects to the MQTT broker your ramses_esp already uses, for example the MQTT Broker app on Homey. It finds the gateway by itself, scans the bus for devices and shows live traffic with decoded values in the app settings.

Unofficial community app; not made or endorsed by the manufacturers of the devices or by the ramses_esp authors.
